genius.issuerEntity: Financial Reserves and Asset Exploration Inc. (dba FRAX Inc)
genius.licensingRegulator: Not established by the cited issuer proposals; OCC references describe the general proposed federal framework.
genius.notes: FIP-430 and FIP-432 announce payment-stablecoin charter preparation and assign issuer-level compliance and collateral management to FRAX Inc. FIP-441 further proposes exclusive frxUSD issuance rights for regulated operation including GENIUS. These token-specific issuer materials establish intent, not an official application or approval. FIP-432 leaves the appropriate U.S. license to the board; neither a GENIUS issuer pathway nor a licensing regulator was established. The public regulator review is dated 2026-10-07 and cannot exclude confidential, unindexed or differently named filings. The live frxUSD balance-sheet API is an issuer reserve disclosure, not an independent monthly attestation; the transparency web route returned only an application shell. FIP-432 voting success was not independently established and is not asserted. FraxNet account-yield marketing and the separate sfrxUSD strategy product are not evidence of compliance or authorization. MiCA EU offering and authorization were reviewed separately and remain unresolved; no parent or custodian license is transferred.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The opened OCC public pending digital-asset licensing table contains no Frax, FRAX Inc, Financial Reserves and Asset Exploration or FinresPBC entry. NYDFS directory and official-domain exact-name searches established no frxUSD PPSI approval, state qualification, official GENIUS pending application, foreign registration or action. FIP-430/432/441 establish issuer intent only. These are public, bounded searches; confidential or differently named filings are not excluded.
